raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Theuderic I (Theuderic the Great) as "Theodoric the Great," who was the king of the Ostrogoths. Theuderic I was actually a Merovingian king and the father of Theudebert I. This error led to the wrong conclusion that Theodoric the Great was Wisigard’s father-in-law, rather than the correct answer, Theuderic I. This misidentification occurred during the step when WebSurfer reported the relationship between Theudebert I and his father based on the search results.
